title: Noise operator acts diagonally in the Fourier domain
statement:
Let $\rho\in\bbr$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, and let $S\subseteq[n]$. Then the Fourier--Walsh coefficient of the noise-operator image $T_\rho f$ at frequency $S$ is
\[
  \widehat{T_\rho f}(S) \;=\; \rho^{\abs{S}}\,\hat f(S).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
